data_note: Baselines are means/stds over days that had >=1 detection, not zero-filled daily rates -- see data_audit.py. No independent fire-occurrence ground truth exists in this dataset; nothing below is an accuracy metric.
full_history_caveat: Training windows here can span the pre-2012 MODIS-only era and the post-2012 MODIS+VIIRS era in the same baseline -- a real confound (more sensors, not necessarily more fire) flagged in the Stage 1 audit. Included for completeness; the VIIRS-era-only run below is the one that avoids this confound.

qualitative_year_check.caveat: Qualitative sanity check only. 'High/low activity year' is based on this dataset's own yearly detection totals (Stage 1 audit), not an independent fire-occurrence record. Do not read this as accuracy or validation.
